sentences.text:
We have heard Mr. Patel, learned Additional Government Pleader for Respondent No.1-Competent Authority, Ms. Karnik, learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner, Mr. Deshmukh,
learned Counsel for respondent Nos.3 and 4 and Ms. Jariwala, learned Counsel for respondent No.2-National Highway Authorities of India.
Prakash Sonajee Mahale vs Competent Authority (Expressway) And ... on 8 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96937515/
1 2.

The only substantive prayer as made in this petition in the context of the land acquisition is prayer clause (a) which reads thus:-
"(a) This Hon'ble Court may please invoke its writ jurisdiction under Article 226 of the Constitution of India and issue a writ of certiorari or a Writ, direction or order in the nature of certiorari and/or a writ of mandamus or a writ, direction or order in the nature of mandamus and direct the Respondent No.1 to refer the Land Reference Application dated 08/02/2022 (Exb.I) concerning dispute between Petitioner and 08 August, 2024 9WP4856-22GRP.DOC Respondent Nos.3 and 4 to the Principal Civil Court of Original Jurisdiction at Thane u/s. 3-H(4) of the National Highways Act,1956 for adjudication."
3.
There is no dispute about the relation between the petitioner and respondent Nos.3 and 4, who are sisters of the petitioner's father.
A part of the land acquisition compensation in regard to the acquisition in question as undertaken by the National Highways Authority, is already received by the petitioner.
Respondent Nos. 3 and 4 are also claiming part of the compensation and thus there is certainly a dispute in regard to apportionment of the compensation.

If, this be so, certainly, it is the case of dispute on apportionment of compensation and it is required to be referred to a Civil Court under the provisions of Section 3-H(4) of the National Highways Act, 1956 namely the Principal Civil Court of Original jurisdiction at Palghar.

entities.text: Principal Civil Court of Original jurisdiction at Palghar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In this regard, the petitioner has made an application dated 8 February 2022 to the Competent Authority - respondent No.1 under Section 3-H(4) of the National Highways Act,1956.
The same is pending and a reference of dispute is not made to the appropriate Principal Civil Court of Original jurisdiction.

4. Considering the nature of the grievance and after hearing the learned Counsel for the parties, we are of the opinion that this is a fit case where respondent No.2 be directed to make a reference of apportionment of the compensation between the petitioners and respondent Nos.3 and 4 to the Principal Civil Court of Original jurisdiction at Palghar, within a period of three weeks from today.

entities.text: Principal Civil Court of Original jurisdiction at Palghar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: We dispose of the petition in the aforesaid terms.
All contentions of the parties in the reference proceedings are expressly kept open to be adjudicated in such proceedings.
